                                                                                                                                                                                                    The correct answer is Ammonium hydroxide.Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The aqueous solution, ammonium hydroxide, is created by saturating water with gaseous ammonia.
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The colorless ammonium hydroxide solution is a weak basic.
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • It does not entirely ionize, leaving the water molecule.
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • This solution is employed as a buffer solution, or a solution that is used to modify the pH in a chemical reaction.                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Because the concentration of OH- ions in the solution rises, the basicity of the solution also rises.
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • A strong reagent with the ability to dissolve stains brought on by vegetable fats, animal fats, etc. is ammonium hydroxide.
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • As a result, the substance is effective as a cleaning agent and readily vaporizes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Thus, it is a component of detergents for cleaning glass, windows, and other surfaces.
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\nGiven:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Quotients = 1, 5, 8

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Last Divisor = 57

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Formula used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    LCM(a, b) = (a × b) / HCF(a, b)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    To find the two numbers, we'll work backward from the last division.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    The last divisor is 57 and the remainder is 0 (since it's the HCF calculation).

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Second to last divisor = 57 × 8 + 0 = 456

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    This divisor (456) is the remainder of the previous step. The second to last quotient is 5.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Third to last divisor = 456 × 5 + 57 = 2280 + 57 = 2337

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    This divisor (2337) is the remainder of the first step. The first quotient is 1.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    First number = 2337 × 1 + 456 = 2337 + 456 = 2793

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    The two numbers are 2337 and 2793.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    The HCF of these numbers is the last divisor, which is 57.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Now, we can calculate the LCM:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    LCM = (2337 × 2793) / 57

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ LCM = 2337 × 49

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ LCM = 114513

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ The LCM of the two numbers is 114,513.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    भागफल = 1, 5, 8

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    अंतिम भाजक = 57

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    भाज्य = भाजक × भागफल + शेषफल

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    LCM(a, b) = (a × b) / HCF(a, b)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    गणनाएँ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    दो संख्याएँ ज्ञात करने के लिए, हम अंतिम भाग से पीछे की ओर काम करेंगे।

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    अंतिम भाजक 57 है और शेषफल 0 है (चूँकि यह HCF गणना है)।

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    दूसरा अंतिम भाजक = 57 × 8 + 0 = 456

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    यह भाजक (456) पिछले चरण का शेषफल है। दूसरा अंतिम भागफल 5 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    तीसरा अंतिम भाजक = 456 × 5 + 57 = 2280 + 57 = 2337

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    यह भाजक (2337) पहले चरण का शेषफल है। पहला भागफल 1 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    पहली संख्या = 2337 × 1 + 456 = 2337 + 456 = 2793

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    दो संख्याएँ 2337 और 2793 हैं।

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    इन संख्याओं का HCF अंतिम भाजक है, जो 57 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    अब, हम LCM की गणना कर सकते हैं:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    LCM = (2337 × 2793) / 57

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ LCM = 2337 × 49

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ LCM = 114513

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ दो संख्याओं का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य 114,513 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ఇచ్చినది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    భాగఫలాలు = 1, 5, 8

                                                                                                                                                                                                    చివరి విభాజకం = 57

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    విభాజ్యం = విభాజకం x భాగఫలం + శేషం

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    క.సా.గు(a, b) = (a x b) / గ.సా.కా(a, b)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    లెక్కలు:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    రెండు సంఖ్యలను కనుగొనడానికి, చివరి విభాగం నుండి వెనక్కి పని చేస్తాము.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    చివరి విభాజకం 57 మరియు శేషం 0 (ఇది గ.సా.కా లెక్కింపు కాబట్టి).

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    చివరి నుండి రెండవ విభాజకం = 57 x 8 + 0 = 456

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ఈ విభాజకం (456) మునుపటి దశ యొక్క శేషం. చివరి నుండి రెండవ భాగఫలం 5.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    చివరి నుండి మూడవ విభాజకం = 456 x 5 + 57 = 2280 + 57 = 2337

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ఈ విభాజకం (2337) మొదటి దశ యొక్క శేషం. మొదటి భాగఫలం 1.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    మొదటి సంఖ్య = 2337 x 1 + 456 = 2337 + 456 = 2793

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    రెండు సంఖ్యలు 2337 మరియు 2793.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ఈ సంఖ్యల గ.సా.కా చివరి విభాజకం, ఇది 57.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ఇప్పుడు, మనం క.సా.గును లెక్కించవచ్చు:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    క.సా.గు = (2337 x 2793) / 57

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ క.సా.గు = 2337 x 49

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ క.సా.గు = 114513

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ రెండు సంఖ్యల క.సా.గు 114,513.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ ଦୁଇଟି ସଂଖ୍ୟାର ଲ.ସା.ଗୁ. ହେଉଛି 114,513 |

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਭਾਗਫਲ = 1, 5, 8

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਆਖਰੀ ਭਾਜਕ = 57

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਫਾਰਮੂਲਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਲਾਭਅੰਸ਼ = ਭਾਜਕ x ਭਾਗਫਲ + ਬਾਕੀ

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    LCM(a, b) = (a x b) / HCF(a, b)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਗਣਨਾਵਾਂ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਦੋ ਸੰਖਿਆਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਲੱਭਣ ਲਈ, ਅਸੀਂ ਆਖਰੀ ਭਾਗ ਤੋਂ ਪਿੱਛੇ ਵੱਲ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਾਂਗੇ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਆਖਰੀ ਭਾਜਕ 57 ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਬਾਕੀ 0 ਹੈ (ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਇਹ HCF ਗਣਨਾ ਹੈ)।

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਆਖਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਜਕ = 57 x 8 + 0 = 456

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਇਹ ਭਾਜਕ (456) ਪਿਛਲੇ ਪੜਾਅ ਦਾ ਬਾਕੀ ਹੈ। ਆਖਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਗਫਲ 5 ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਆਖਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਤੀਜਾ ਭਾਜਕ = 456 x 5 + 57 = 2280 + 57 = 2337

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਇਹ ਭਾਜਕ (2337) ਪਹਿਲੇ ਪੜਾਅ ਦਾ ਬਾਕੀ ਹੈ। ਪਹਿਲਾ ਭਾਗਫਲ 1 ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਪਹਿਲੀ ਸੰਖਿਆ = 2337 x 1 + 456 = 2337 + 456 = 2793

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਦੋ ਸੰਖਿਆਵਾਂ 2337 ਅਤੇ 2793 ਹਨ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਇਹਨਾਂ ਸੰਖਿਆਵਾਂ ਦਾ HCF ਆਖਰੀ ਭਾਜਕ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਕਿ 57 ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਹੁਣ, ਅਸੀਂ LCM ਦੀ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਾਂ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    LCM = (2337 x 2793) / 57

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ LCM = 2337 x 49

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ LCM = 114513

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ ਦੋ ਸੰਖਿਆਵਾਂ ਦਾ LCM 114,513 ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                    CONCEPT:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Momentum (P): The product of mass and velocity is called a momentum of the system.
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Momentum (P) = Mass (m) × Velocity (V)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Conservation of momentum: Whenever there is no net external force on the system then the total momentum of the system remains constant.
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Initial momentum (P1) = Final momentum (P2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    CALCULATION:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • As there is no external force on the pistol and bullet system. So the total momentum of the system will remain constant.
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Initially the system was in rest so velocity (V) = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Initial momentum (P1) = mass (m) × Velocity (V) = m × 0 = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    After firing,

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Velocity of bullet (Vb) = 100 m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Mass of bullet (mb) = 20 g = 20/1000 = 0.02 kg

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Momentum of bullet (Pb) = mb × Vb = 0.02 × 100 = 2 kg m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Let recoil velocity of pistol = V m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Mass of rifle (mr) = 8 kg

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Momentum of rifle (Pr) = mr × V = 8 × V = 8V kg m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Total final momentum of the system (P2) = Momentum of rifle + momentum of bullet = (8V + 2) kg m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    According to conservation of momentum;

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Initial momentum (P1) = Final momentum (P2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    0 = 8V + 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    V = - 2/8 = - 1/4 = - 0.25  m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    The negative sign denotes opposite direction. So the recoil velocity of pistol is 0.25 m/s.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Hence option 4 is correct.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    अवधारणा:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • संवेग (P) : द्रव्यमान और वेग के उत्पाद को प्रणाली का संवेग कहा जाता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    संवेग (P) = द्रव्यमान (m) × वेग (V)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • संवेग का संरक्षण: जब भी प्रणाली पर कोई शुद्ध बाह्य बल नहीं होता है तब प्रणाली का कुल संवेग स्थिर रहता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    प्रारंभिक संवेग (P1) = अंतिम संवेग (P2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • चूंकि पिस्तौल और गोली प्रणाली पर कोई बाहरी बल नहीं है तो प्रणाली का कुल संवेग स्थिर रहेगा।
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    प्रारंभ में प्रणाली विरामावस्था पर थी इसलिए वेग (V) = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    प्रारंभिक संवेग (P1) = द्रव्यमान (m) × वेग (V) = m × 0 = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    गोली चलाने के बाद,

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    गोली का वेग (Vb) = 100 m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    गोली का द्रव्यमान (mb) = = 20 g = 20/1000 = 0.02 kg

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    गोली का संवेग (Pb) = mb × Vb = 0.02 × 100 = 2 kg m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    माना कि पिस्तौल का प्रतिक्षेप वेग = V m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    राइफल का द्रव्यमान (mr) = 8 kg

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    राइफल का संवेग (Pr ) = mr × V = 8 × V = 8V kg m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    प्रणाली का कुल अंतिम संवेग (P2) = राइफल का संवेग + गोली का संवेग = (8V + 2) kg m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    संवेग के संरक्षण के अनुसार;

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    प्रारंभिक संवेग (P1) = अंतिम संवेग (P2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    0 = 8V + 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    V = - 2/8 = - 1/4 = - 0.25 m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    ऋणात्मक चिह्न विपरीत दिशा को दर्शाता है। तो पिस्तौल का प्रतिक्षेप वेग 0.25 m/s है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                    इसलिए विकल्प 4 सही है।
